_about: Martial arts and cultivation: sects, grudges, manuals and the jianghu. Designed by us. Story axes for story_gen.py. Each axis is rolled on its own; an entry is a string (weight 1) or {v, w, decay}. All text is our own.

sect: a mountain sword sect in decline
a sect of healers who will not fight
a wandering opera troupe that teaches fists
grudge: a master killed twenty years ago
treasure: a pill that breaks a realm
a jade token for a hidden valley
bottleneck: the next realm needs a tribulation
their qi turns cold under pressure
a wound that blocks a meridian
a heart-demon from an old sin
rival: a sworn sibling who chose the other side
an elder who wants their manual
a demonic cultivator who saved their life
jianghu_rule: no one draws a blade at the inn
debts of life must be repaid
the orthodox and the unorthodox do not mix
the court stays out of the jianghu, until now

cliches: a cliff with a secret manual at the bottom
